column1: # TFC precipitation decision golden, source TerraFirmaCraft@c3b4d9536, hand-traced from src/main/java/net/dries007/tfc/util/tracker/WeatherHelpers.java
# Line refs: L99 rainIntensity = weather enabled ? getRain : -1; L102 isPrecipitating gate; L103 snow threshold (temperature > 0f);
# L104 RAIN; L105 SNOW; L106 NONE; L116 isPrecipitating (real intensity > 0); L121 calculateRealRainIntensity (intensity - clampedMap(rainfall, 0, 500, 1, 0)).
# The sky gate is not in WeatherHelpers: vanilla Level.isRainingAt checks canSeeSky before the biome call that TFC replaces (see the javadoc of getPrecipitationAt, L80-87).
# Precipitation states: wet = intensity 0.75 at 250 mm (real 0.25); weather off = intensity -1 (L99); dry air = 0.75 at 0 mm (real -0.25);
# no rain = intensity 0 at 500 mm (real 0, not above zero).

column8: wet but no sky: vanilla gate first
no rain: real 0 is not above zero
at zero the test is strict: not above zero is snow
smallest positive float is above zero
smallest negative float is not above zero
